sources.title: README.md · empero-ai/Qwen3.8-9B-Distill at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-9B is a full-parameter distillation of Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B into the Qwen3.5-9B architecture. The student was trained on ~70,000 curated teacher traces from our internal Qwen3.8 distillation datasets — dense chain-of-thought spanning mathematics, code, general reasoning, instruction following, and tool use, quality-filtered before training.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-9B: Running the Community-Distilled Model Locally
sources.snippet: What is Qwen3.8-9B? Qwen3.8-9B is an unofficial, community-built distillation of Alibaba's Qwen 3.8 model, released by a team called Empero. Alibaba's Qwen 3.8 lands at 27 billion parameters (with reports of a much larger internal teacher configuration), which puts it out of reach for anyone without a serious GPU budget. sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-9B-Distill is a 9-billion-parameter causal language model developed by empero-ai that distills frontier-scale reasoning capabilities from Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B into a single-GPU deployable form. sources.snippet: The Teacher Model (Qwen3.8-2.4T): A massive AI running on multi-million dollar data centers. It generates step-by-step reasoning solutions ("Chain of Thought"). The Student Models (9B / 4B / 2B): Smaller models trained directly on the teacher's exact reasoning traces.
